data.description:
## Context / Problem

Pass 2 (`src/rebar/llm/review_kernel/verify.py`, questions in `verify_models.py`, prompts `reviewers/plan_review_verifier*.md`, `temperature: 0`, standard class = Sonnet on Bedrock) is the cheapest LLM pass (~$0.5/review uncached, ~1 call with ~12 requests) and the one whose questions most directly set validity/impact. A question or prompt change can be measured by re-verifying the *stored* Pass-1 findings and comparing to the stored answers — no Opus needed. `verify_findings(findings, context, run_chunk=…)` already exposes the pure seam; `plan-review-verifier.eval.yaml` has no `run_case` arm yet.

## Approach

Build `src/rebar/llm/evals/plan_replay/tier1.py`:

- Sample selection: deterministic stratified sample from the corpus (strata: verdict, leaf/container, finding count bucket, project overlay/store, `impact_model_version`), size N given on the command line, seed fixed; only `verified` rows (reconstructed plan text) are eligible; only rows whose `provider_provenance.ran_model` is the current standard-class model.
- For each sampled review: build the verifier context from reconstructed plan text + stored findings (`finding, criteria, evidence, impact, location`), run the candidate verifier (prompt/questions from a candidate path; default = current) through the production `PydanticAIRunner` pinned to the standard class on Bedrock, collect `{binary, severity_attributes}`.
- Compare to stored answers: per-question agreement (Cohen κ and raw agreement per graded binary and veto question; per-attribute agreement for severity attributes), validity/impact/priority distribution shift, then hand both answer sets to Tier 0 for the downstream verdict/label metrics.
- A **reproduction run** (candidate = current) is the first commissioning run: its agreement is the verifier noise floor at temperature 0 and is stored with the labels.
- All calls go through the budget ledger pre-flight (estimate = stored `metrics` tokens × current price × N) and record the model id per result.

## Scope

- `src/rebar/llm/evals/plan_replay/tier1.py`, `sampling.py` (new)
- `src/rebar/llm/evals/eval_solver.py` (add the verifier `run_case` arm)
- `docs/experiments/plan-review-gate/replay/tier1-*.md` (generated)
- `tests/unit/evals/test_plan_replay_tier1.py` (new)

## Testing

Unit: sampling is deterministic for a seed and respects strata; a `FakeRunner` returning canned verifications yields the expected per-question agreement table; a run whose pre-flight estimate exceeds the ledger allocation is refused before any call; a result with a non-standard-class model id is rejected at diff time. Live (commissioning, ≤$40): the reproduction run on N=60.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `python -m rebar.llm.evals.plan_replay tier1 --candidate <path> --n N` produces per-question agreement, distribution shift and downstream Tier-0 metrics for a stratified sample; checked by one generated report.
- [ ] The reproduction run (current questions) is recorded with its per-question agreement as the Pass-2 noise floor; checked by the report and the labels file.
- [ ] Every call in the run is priced in the ledger and uses the Bedrock standard-class model id; checked by the ledger rows for the run.
- [ ] Commissioning spend for this ticket ≤ $40; checked by the ledger.
- [ ] Unit tests pass in `make test`.
data.title: Tier-1 harness: replay Pass-2 impact/validity questions on stored Pass-1 findings (Sonnet via Bedrock, budgeted)
